labels: A short pea coat ends at the upper thighs, with broad lapels above two button columns and a double-breasted overlapping front.; 짧은 피코트가 허벅지 위에서 끝나고 넓은 라펠 아래에 두 단추 열과 겹친 더블브레스트 앞판이 보인다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: A short pea coat ends at the upper thighs, with broad lapels above two button columns and a double-breasted overlapping front.
aliases: 피코트의 짧은 겹침
